title: 折叠屏iPhone：下周见，两年近十款新品能撑起增长吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I am so damn excited for the foldable phone. You have no idea. I'm excited to see this. I'm excited to see how it folds
segments.zh: 我对折叠屏手机超级兴奋，你无法想象。我很期待看到它，以及它是如何折叠的。

segments.en: Are you going to get one? Hell no. But I respect Mark's enthusiasm very much. These next two to three years are going to be the most
segments.zh: 你会买一个吗？绝对不会。但我非常尊重马克的热情。接下来的两到三年将是苹果历史上最多产的新品年份。

segments.en: prolific new product years in Apple's history. We're talking close to ten major new product categories in the opening act of
segments.zh: 我们说的是在约翰·特努斯任期的开场阶段，将近十个主要新产品类别。

segments.en: John Ternus's tenure. Wow. It'll all start next Wednesday at the Apple surprise and shine event with no surprises. You'll see the company's first foldable iPhone. That'll be a major new product category. The other major new product category being launched this year is a smart home display. It's got a seven inch square screen. Has facial recognition. You walk up to it. Have a bunch of people in the house. You'll know who's who and it'll tailor the content on the display and in the series.
segments.zh: 哇。这一切将从下周三的苹果惊喜与闪耀活动开始，毫无意外。你会看到公司首款折叠屏iPhone，那将是一个主要的新产品类别。今年推出的另一个主要新产品类别是智能家居显示屏。它有七英寸方形屏幕，具备面部识别功能。你走近它，家里有多个人时，它能识别出谁是谁，并调整显示内容。

segments.en: It'll be announced at this event or in October but it should be out before end of year or early next year. Third major new product category. So three product categories in three months versus in 15 years.
segments.zh: 它将在这次活动或十月份公布，但应该在年底或明年初上市。第三个主要新产品类别。所以三个月内三个产品类别，对比15年。

segments.en: So first touchscreen MacBook will start a whole range of touchscreen Max. That'll come out before end of year early next year as well. In terms of some of the other incremental stuff this year you'll see new air pods, the low end air pods. You'll see the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max.
segments.zh: 首款触屏MacBook将开启一系列触屏Mac，也将在年底或明年初推出。至于今年其他一些增量产品，你会看到新款AirPods，低端AirPods，以及iPhone 18 Pro和18 Pro Max。
